title: A nickel(II) complex of a naphthaldehyde-derived bis-imine ligand for sunlight-driven dye remediation: mechanistic, intermediate identification, and recyclability studies
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,1949-1963
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00958H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nilotpal Goswami, Diganta Kumar Bharali, Nabajit Barman, Pranjit Barman
A new Ni(II) complex of an unsymmetric Schiff base ligand was used as a photocatalyst in the degradation of cationic dyes in water under sunlight. Thus, providing a sustainable, cost-effective, and energy-efficient water remediation approach.
